task.title: [P2] Add accumulators and batch sum, dotProduct and fma operations
task.body:
Chains of immutable operations create temporary values. An additional API can reuse memory and specify the rounding policy explicitly.

Design an accumulator and sum/dotProduct/fma operations with safe ownership of working state. Distinguish rounding after each step from rounding the final exact result once; do not substitute one policy for the other. Define empty-input behavior, scale, overflow and limits on intermediate work.

Acceptance: a documented contract and examples where single-rounding fma differs from multiply(mc).add(mc); checks using exact independent calculations, cancellation/compensation of terms, signs and rounding boundaries. Immutable result snapshots must not change as the accumulator continues working. Measurements must show the benefit over ordinary chains and the cost of wide results.

General constraints: independent implementation; do not use OpenJDK sources or those of third-party numerical libraries. Preserve the guarantees of the agreed public contract; no speedup measurements are currently available. Do not touch other people's uncommitted changes.

---
Created by: Codex
Git branch: main

activity.author: 2455b459
activity.text: Prepared new additive DecimalAccumulator/sumDecimals/dotProduct/fma source in /private/tmp/krogu-math-535 frommain7de2d8a; no existing kernels edited. Explicit FINAL_RESULT exact-state/snapshot-round vs EACH_STEP multiply/context-add policy, with initial-product zero cohort preserved. Private Long same-scale exact sum reuses state, checked overflow promotes to immutable wide arithmetic; subclasses are observed via coefficient/scale snapshots. Explicit conservative maxWorkingDigits/maxTerms budgets check Long bounds before work, and failures leave state unchanged. Common literal fma/cancellation/snapshot/limit tests and public-JDK compositions prepared. Independent source/test review decimal_keys_536 found no blocker; extra extreme-scale/product-failure/iterator controls added. Source/tests UNCOMPILED/UNRUN; no numerical/performance claim; benefit vs chains and wide-cost measurements remain required after527. Changes are not committed.

activity.author: 2455b459
activity.text: Scope correction after independent review: FINAL_RESULT no longer chains public-range intermediates. New private DecimalSignedWork535 uses Long scales and paged signed radix-10^9 cells, allowing unsupported intermediate coefficients/scales before cancellation and one final rounding. Signed carries preserve |cell|<10^9; sparse borrow runs avoid alignment-sized arrays; school products split low/high before 10^r alignment; byte/radix import and binary publication avoid decimal String caps. Final exact binary-length certification and equivalent-cohort rescue occur only at snapshot. Default work/term budgets are now null (no arbitrary extra cap); explicit caller budgets remain conservative and Long-bounded. Added tiny scale-overflow cancellation, >4-billion-digit private span cancellation/borrow, and equivalent cohort witnesses. Reviewer identified an UNRUN source counterexample where truncation creates quotient zeros; general retained-quotient zero scan fixed, with signed/all-mode/carry/no-rescue regressions and re-review approval. No open source findings, but code/tests remain UNCOMPILED/UNRUN and performance evidence still required. Earlier additive-only/public-intermediate description in comment2564 is superseded by this expanded implementation. No existing BigInteger/BigDecimal kernels edited.

Independent diagnostic review approved fairness/DCE and hardening: exact expected candidate SHA, adapter loader/origin and script/artifact hashes. No measurements or speedup claimed. Added seventh common test covering nested add/product/clear under both policies, unchanged state, budget witness, getter exception identity and reset. Expanded arithmetic kernel and measurement script unchanged; all535 code/tests still UNCOMPILED/UNRUN. Previous source approval remains for arithmetic/diagnostic, but this ownership delta awaits independent source review by benchmarks_527 after cleanup report. activity.author: 2455b459
activity.text: Independent source review of the new reentrancy ownership delta by benchmarks_527: PASS, no blockers. Guard acquisition precedes budget/getter callbacks; nested mutation fails before flag/state changes; outer finally resets after getter exceptions; clear blocks mutation while snapshot remains read-only. Internal per-step product/add uses private core correctly. New test covers nested3mutators ×2policies ×2outer operations, explicit maxTerms witness, unchanged state/size, exception identity and successful reuse. Expanded numerical helper unchanged.
